name: TwilightPrincessRandomizer
randomizer: built into the signed Dusklight executable; packaged data bundle contains no native DLL
duplicateSettingOptions: removed and guarded by both build-time and runtime validation
controllerCursor: hold L3+R3 in a Dusklight menu; move with the right stick and click or drag with A
texturePacks: loose files and ZIP packs under texture_replacements load automatically at startup
menuColors: manual, Rainbow, per-seed, and every-load menu palette modes
xboxLoaderHotfix: Uses AppContainer JIT memory APIs with write-or-execute transitions for built-in Randomizer hook trampolines
xboxAudioSafeBoot: Game audio remains temporarily disabled on UWP; audio replacement lifecycle remains isolated
xboxNewSaveGate: All new-save routes, including missing or damaged virtual memory cards, must complete Randomizer seed selection before name entry
